name: core-runtime-database-result-dto-local-evidence
salesforceExclusionReason: This fixture proves Glade-local Database result DTO property aliases and Object methods. It does not establish Salesforce property-alias availability and grants zero Salesforce parity credit.

source.content: @isTest private class DatabaseResultDTOLocalEvidenceTest { @isTest static void resultPropertiesAndObjectMethodsExecute() { Account base = new Account(Name = 'Base'); Database.SaveResult saved = Database.insert(base, false); System.assertEquals(saved.isSuccess(), saved.success); System.assertEquals(saved.getId(), saved.id); System.assertEquals(saved.getErrors(), saved.errors); System.assert(saved.equals(saved)); System.assertNotEquals(null, saved.hashCode()); System.assertNotEquals(null, saved.toString()); Account upsertRow = new Account(Name = 'Upsert'); Database.UpsertResult upserted = Database.upsert(upsertRow, false); System.assertEquals(upserted.isCreated(), upserted.created); System.assertEquals(upserted.isSuccess(), upserted.success); System.assertEquals(upserted.getId(), upserted.id); System.assertEquals(upserted.getErrors(), upserted.errors); System.assert(upserted.equals(upserted)); System.assertNotEquals(null, upserted.hashCode()); System.assertNotEquals(null, upserted.toString()); Account master = new Account(Name = 'Master'); insert master; Account duplicate = new Account(Name = 'Duplicate'); insert duplicate; Database.MergeResult merged = Database.merge(master, duplicate, false); System.assertEquals(merged.isSuccess(), merged.success); System.assertEquals(merged.getId(), merged.id); System.assertEquals(merged.getMergedRecordIds(), merged.mergedrecordids); System.assertEquals(merged.getUpdatedRelatedIds(), merged.updatedrelatedids); System.assert(merged.equals(merged)); System.assertNotEquals(null, merged.hashCode()); System.assertNotEquals(null, merged.toString()); Account recycle = new Account(Name = 'Recycle'); insert recycle; Database.DeleteResult deleted = Database.delete(recycle, false); System.assertEquals(deleted.isSuccess(), deleted.success); System.assertEquals(deleted.getId(), deleted.id); System.assertEquals(deleted.getErrors(), deleted.errors); System.assert(deleted.equals(deleted)); System.assertNotEquals(null, deleted.hashCode()); System.assertNotEquals(null, deleted.toString()); Database.UndeleteResult restored = Database.undelete(recycle, false); System.assertEquals(restored.isSuccess(), restored.success); System.assertEquals(restored.getId(), restored.id); System.assertEquals(restored.getErrors(), restored.errors); System.assert(restored.equals(restored)); System.assertNotEquals(null, restored.hashCode()); System.assertNotEquals(null, restored.toString()); Database.delete(recycle, false); Database.EmptyRecycleBinResult emptied = Database.emptyRecycleBin(recycle); System.assertEquals(emptied.isSuccess(), emptied.success); System.assertEquals(emptied.getId(), emptied.id); System.assertEquals(emptied.getErrors(), emptied.errors); System.assert(emptied.equals(emptied)); System.assertNotEquals(null, emptied.hashCode()); System.assertNotEquals(null, emptied.toString()); } }
